sentences.en: Hopefully you can rest and relax on the flight home.
sentences.zh: 希望你能在家途中飞行时休息放松。

sentences.en: To travel hopefully is a better thing than to arrive.
sentences.zh: 满怀期待地旅行比到达更有意义。

sentences.en: Hopefully they don't delay my flight like the others.
sentences.zh: 但愿他们不会像其他人那样延误我的航班。

senses.zh: 怀有希望地；如果顺利的话，可望
